description: AuRAG Golden Industrial Evaluation Benchmark Suite (52 Real-World Scenarios)

cases.query: What caused feed pump P-101 to experience severe high vibration and mechanical seal leakage in March 2025?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must cite bearing misalignment, impeller cavitation, and delayed preventive maintenance work order WO-1002.

cases.query: Why did process gas compressor C-201 trip automatically on high discharge temperature during peak load?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must identify stage 2 discharge valve carbon buildup and cooling water circulation drop.

cases.query: What was the root cause of the differential pressure spike and severe fouling inside heat exchanger HX-401?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must reference heavy crude asphaltene deposition on tube bundles and delayed backwash cycle.

cases.query: Why did pressure safety valve PSV-701 fail to lift at its certified set pressure of 24.5 bar on surge vessel V-301?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must highlight spring corrosion, polymer sticking, and overdue annual recalibration.

cases.query: What caused the drive motor MOT-901 for pump P-101 to overheat and trip the circuit breaker?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must cite winding thermal overload caused by mechanical pump seizure and cooling fan blockage.

cases.query: Why did control valve FCV-801 fail in the closed position during normal feed section operations?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must trace pneumatic actuator diaphragm rupture and instrument air moisture contamination.

cases.query: What led to the sudden loss of suction head and cavitation excursion in standby feed pump P-102?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must identify suction strainer blockage and low level in feed tank TK-101.

cases.query: What was the origin of the lubricating oil contamination detected on compressor C-202?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must cite cross-head seal degradation allowing condensate ingress into the crankcase reservoir.

cases.query: Why did separator vessel V-302 exhibit severe liquid carryover into the downstream gas header?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must identify demister pad dislodgement and faulty level control valve response.

cases.query: What initiated the thermal cracking failure on the tube sheet of trim cooler HX-402?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must trace cyclic thermal fatigue from rapid bypass valve switching and cooling water temperature swings.

cases.query: Why did reflux control valve CV-110 oscillate uncontrollably on distillation tower T-501?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must cite valve positioner calibration drift and aggressive PID tuning constants.

cases.query: What caused the localized hot spot and catalyst bed channeling inside primary reaction vessel R-601?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must identify feed distributor tray fouling and uneven catalyst sock-loading density.

cases.query: Why did raw feed storage tank TK-101 experience breather valve vapor release during ambient heating?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must reference thermal vapor expansion exceeding pressure-vacuum relief valve pallet seating force.

cases.query: What root mechanism caused repetitive outboard bearing failure on crude charge pump A within 90 days?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must highlight piping strain misalignment transferring dynamic radial loads to bearing housing.

cases.query: Why did the emergency shutdown system fail to trip fuel gas supply during flame rollout on feed heater?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must cite single-point failure in bypassed flame scanner voting logic.

cases.query: Is pressure safety valve PSV-701 compliant with statutory inspection and recalibration requirements under OISD-STD-132?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must cite OISD-STD-132 Clause 10.2(ii) mandating documented testing history prior to recalibration.

cases.query: Does operating surge vessel V-301 above design pressure violate Section 31 of the Indian Factories Act 1948?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must cite Factories Act Section 31 requiring effective measures to ensure safe working pressure is never exceeded.

cases.query: What are the statutory explosion prevention and ventilation mandates under Factories Act Section 37 for compressor C-201?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must cite enclosure of machinery, prevention of gas accumulation, and exclusion of ignition sources.

cases.query: What medium is legally permitted for hydrostatic testing of pressure relief valves according to OISD-STD-132?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must state that clean water, air, or nitrogen is required, and hydrocarbons/natural gas are strictly prohibited.

cases.query: Under PESO SMPV Rule 18, what is the mandatory inspection interval for pressurized hydrocarbon storage vessels?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must cite statutory 2-year visual inspection and 5-year hydraulic proof test intervals under PESO.

cases.query: Are we legally compliant if a safety valve bench test record is missing the inspector's stamp and test certificate?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must flag non-compliance due to absence of authorized third-party certification and historical logs.

cases.query: What does OISD-116 mandate regarding fire water pump auto-start response times during main power failure?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must mandate diesel secondary fire pump auto-start within 30 seconds of ring header pressure drop.

cases.query: Does reactor R-601 require an emergency depressurization system under OSHA 1910.119 Process Safety Management?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must reference OSHA PSM emergency relief system requirements for runaway reaction mitigation.

cases.query: What statutory documentation is required before returning distillation tower T-501 to service after hot work?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must list gas-free certification, confined space permit closure, and structural weld radiograph signoffs.

cases.query: What are the regulatory requirements under OISD-156 for mechanical seal barrier fluid pressurization on toxic pumps?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must specify barrier pressure maintained at minimum 1.5 bar above maximum seal chamber pressure.

cases.query: Is operating separator V-302 with a disabled high-level alarm permitted under the site safety management plan?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must classify alarm defeat without formal Management of Change (MOC) as a critical safety violation.

cases.query: What are the earthing and bonding statutory guidelines for atmospheric storage tank TK-101 to prevent static ignition?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must cite maximum resistance to ground (<10 ohms) and continuous cross-bonding of floating roof shunts.

cases.query: What calibration frequency is mandated for combustible gas detectors installed around compressor C-201?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must specify quarterly bump test and annual multi-point calibration with certified methane gas.

cases.query: Under the Factories Act, what mandatory medical surveillance records must be maintained for chemical operators?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must cite annual health checkups, pulmonary function tests, and permanent retention of exposure records.

cases.query: Can emergency shutdown valves (ESDVs) be isolated for online maintenance without plant throughput reduction?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must mandate risk assessment, physical bypass gagging authorization, and dedicated operator surveillance.

cases.query: What recurring maintenance patterns have been observed across centrifugal pumps over the last two years?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must summarize repeated coupling misalignment, seal face thermocracking, and delayed lube oil top-ups.

cases.query: Which equipment failures were directly traced to deferred preventive maintenance work orders?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must correlate pump bearing catastrophic damage and safety valve failure with deferred PM orders.

cases.query: What lessons were documented following the heat exchanger tube bundle leak in the 2024 turnaround?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must cite aggressive chloride stress corrosion cracking and recommend upgrading tubes to duplex stainless steel.

cases.query: How did previous maintenance crews resolve repeated valve hunting on reflux loop CV-110?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must document the installation of a digital smart positioner with integral derivative damping.

cases.query: What systemic human error factors contributed to past compressor trip incidents during shift handover?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must highlight uncommunicated lube oil filter bypass changes between incoming and outgoing operator crews.

cases.query: What post-incident recommendations were implemented after the storage tank level transmitter freezing event?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must cite the mandatory addition of steam tracing jackets and redundant radar level transmitters.

cases.query: Have we experienced repeated vendor part defects in Sulzer pump mechanical seal replacement cartridges?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must identify silicon carbide seal face flatness deviation in 2024 Q3 replacement batch.

cases.query: What preventive actions were taken to stop repeat fouling on reactor feed distribution nozzles?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must document installation of dual 50-micron upstream basket strainers with differential pressure alarms.

cases.query: What historical trends link motor vibration spikes to seasonal monsoon moisture ingress?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must cite insulation resistance degradation in outdoor terminal boxes and mandate pre-monsoon space heater checks.

cases.query: What best practices were captured for managing catalyst changeout in reactor vessels without inert gas asphyxiation risks?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must mandate continuous nitrogen purge monitoring and dual air-line supplied breathing respirators.

cases.query: What root corrections prevented recurring false trips on compressor high vibration probes?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must cite replacement of unshielded sensor cable with twisted shielded pairs to eliminate electromagnetic noise.

cases.query: What is the standard step-by-step operating procedure for safely starting feed pump P-101 from cold condition?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must specify opening suction valve, priming pump casing, verifying lube oil level, starting motor, and throttling discharge valve.

cases.query: What are the safe operating temperature and pressure thresholds for process gas compressor C-201?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must cite max discharge temperature 135°C and max operating differential pressure 22 bar.

cases.query: How do I perform a manual emergency shutdown of distillation tower T-501 during feed loss?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must detail cutting reboiler steam, stopping reflux, closing bottoms isolation valve, and venting to flare.

cases.query: What is the recommended lube oil grade and viscosity for Sulzer centrifugal feed pumps in Unit 100?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must specify ISO VG 46 mineral turbine oil with anti-wear and anti-foaming additive package.

cases.query: What is the proper procedure to line up the bypass around control valve FCV-801 during maintenance?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must specify manual bypass throttling to match flow transmitter reading before isolating block valves.

cases.query: What are the pre-commissioning pressure leak test criteria for separator vessel V-301?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must specify pneumatic soap bubble leak check at 1.1x design pressure with 30-minute hold.

cases.query: How should an operator respond if feed surge vessel V-301 high-pressure alarm sounds at 22 bar?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must instruct immediately opening manual flare vent, checking upstream feed rate, and verifying PSV readiness.

cases.query: What is the maintenance torque specification for cylinder head studs on reciprocating compressor C-201?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must specify cross-pattern torquing in 3 stages up to 450 Nm with calibrated hydraulic wrench.

cases.query: What are the chemical cleaning flushing guidelines for descaling shell & tube exchanger HX-401?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must mandate 5% inhibited sulfamic acid circulation at 60°C followed by soda ash neutralization rinse.

cases.query: How do I verify that atmospheric storage tank TK-101 inert nitrogen blanketing regulator is functioning?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must specify checking headspace pressure gauge maintains 20-30 mmWC positive pressure.

cases.query: What are the safe vibration alarm and trip setpoints under ISO 10816 for large centrifugal pumps?
cases.grounding_criteria: Must cite ISO 10816-3 Category 2 limits: Alert at 4.5 mm/s RMS, Emergency Trip at 7.1 mm/s RMS.
